Name: Simple Teleport To NPCs
Author: daitsuku
Description:
[center][b][size=5]🎉 Version 0.9.3 is out! 🎉[/size]
[u]Bug fixes for Recent tab translations, controller menus, NPC duplicates, and phantom cellars![/u]

[size=4]🔧 Quality-of-life fixes based on your reports 🔧[/size][/b][/center]


[b][size=4]What's New in 0.9.3:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Recent tab (i18n):[/b] Fixed the Recent tab breaking in non-English languages (empty list, wrong title, no tab highlight). Clicking Recent now works correctly in Chinese, Japanese, and other locales.[/*]
[*][b]Controller support:[/b] Restored native menu controls — left stick moves the cursor, D-pad navigates items, B closes the menu, right stick scrolls. The GMCM option is clarified as [i]Controller Hotkeys[/i] (open menus / warp-to-tile outside menus); in-menu navigation always works.[/*]
[*][b]NPC duplicates:[/b] Warping no longer teleports you to the map edge for dormant/event NPC copies parked at (-4999, -4999). The mod now prefers the active on-map instance.[/*]
[*][b]Cellar list (Standard / Local Search):[/b] Unused Farmhouse Cellar “Second–Eighth Level” entries are hidden unless they belong to a house with the actual cellar upgrade. Extended mode still lists everything.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Mod Overview[/size][/b]
This mod enables players to seamlessly [b]teleport to NPCs, Pets, Farm Animals, and important map Locations [/b]efficiently. By pressing [b]L[/b], a menu will instantly open, displaying a categorized list of available targets.

Simply click on the desired NPC's, Pet's, Animal's, or Location's name to teleport directly to them. To close the menu, press [b]Esc[/b].

[b][size=4]How to Install:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Download the mod file[/*]
[*]Extract it to [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b][/*]
[*][b]Enjoy![/b][/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]General Usage:[/size][/b] 
[list]
[*]Press [b]L[/b] to open the teleportation menu (customizable in GMCM).[/*]
[*]Press [b]H[/b] to open the hotkey assignment menu.[/*]
[*]Click on any name in the list to teleport to them instantly.  [/*]
[*]Press [b]Esc[/b] or click the red [b]X[/b] button on the top right to close the menu.[/*]
[*]Use the [b]search box[/b] at the top to filter names within your current category![/*]
[*]Click the [b]Middle Mouse Button (Scroll Wheel)[/b] to warp directly to your cursor's position on the screen.[/*]
[*][b]Controller:[/b] Use the game's normal menu controls (stick cursor, D-pad, A to select, B to close). Optional controller hotkeys to open menus can be configured in GMCM.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]✨ Universal Favorites System ✨[/size][/b]
You can easily pin your most frequently visited friends, pets, or locations to a dedicated [b]☆ Favorites[/b] tab!
[list]
[*]Hold down the [b]CTRL[/b] key and click on [i]any[/i] item in the [b]NPCs, Locations, Pets, or Animals[/b] tabs to add it to your Favorites list.[/*]
[*]A shiny gold star will appear next to their name![/*]
[*]To remove an item, simply hold [b]CTRL[/b] and click on the item again.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Blacklist System:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Hold down [b]CTRL + ALT[/b] and click on any item you want hidden from the mod.[/*]
[*]To reset your hidden items, use the "Clear Blacklist" button in the Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Mines & Skull Cavern:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Navigate to the [b]Mines[/b] tab.[/*]
[*]Choose between teleporting to [b]The Mines[/b] or [b]Skull Cavern[/b].[/*]
[*]Type the exact floor level you want to reach, then click [i]Warp[/i] or press [b]Enter[/b].[/*]
[*]The Mines floors range from 1 to 120. Skull Cavern ranges from 1 to 2,147,483,646![/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Recent Tab:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Keeps an automatic history of the places and people you most recently warped to![/*]
[*]Can be disabled entirely via GMCM if you don't need it.[/*]
[*]Works correctly with non-English game languages.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Pets and Animals Tabs:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Pets:[/b] Only populates once you have officially adopted your pets.[/*]
[*][b]Animals:[/b] Works for all farm animals! You can instantly warp to animals regardless of whether they are outside grazing or inside their Coop/Barn![/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Location Teleporting (Expanded Map Support):[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Allows teleporting directly to specific map entryways (Farmhouse, Pierre's, The Beach, etc).[/*]
[*]Fixed a notorious bug where warping to JojaMart or Skull Cavern with huge map mods (like Stardew Valley Expanded or Ridgeside) would spawn players in the empty black void. The mod now actively validates and spiral-searches for safe standing tiles![/*]
[*]Unused multi-level / cabin cellar placeholders are no longer listed in Standard or Local Search mode.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]⚙️ Mod Versions (Built Into GMCM!) ⚙️[/size][/b]
You no longer need to download separate "Standard" or "-ext" mod files! You can now toggle the mod's core behavior directly inside the [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b]!
[list]
[*][b]Standard Version:[/b] Displays only NPCs from the [b]Social Tab[/b] (townsfolk you can gain hearts with).[/*]
[*][b]Extended Version:[/b] Displays [b]EVERY NPC[/b] in the game’s code, including temporary event characters and monsters.[/*]
[*][b]Local Search:[/b] Operates identically to Standard Version, but strictly limits the Search Bar to the tab you are currently looking at.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Configuration & Quality of Life:[/size][/b] 
[list]
[*]The UI menu will no longer break or drift off-screen if you use extreme zoom-out mods like [i]Infinite Zoom[/i]. It stays perfectly center-anchored to the UI viewport![/*]
[*]You are highly encouraged to use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] plugin to edit drop-downs, rebind keys, and toggle mod behaviors on the fly without touching JSON files.[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Known Compatibility with Mega-Mods:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url][/b][/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url][/b][/*]
[/list]
[b]Bug Report / Something went wrong:[/b]
[list]
[*]You can DM me.[/*]
[*]Use the Bugs tab on Nexus.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Disclaimer:[/b] 
[quote][b][u][font=Arial]Please note that the use of this mod is at your own risk. The developer is not responsible for any potential issues, including save file corruption.[/font][/u][/b][/quote]
[b]Enjoy your game! ❤️[/b]
